one_line: Ride the 3 hours after an abnormally large ETHUSD H1 candle (|body| > 2.5x 24h mean range), hard stop 2x ATR, never held through 20:00-22:59 UTC rollover.
timeframe: H1 (signal on closed H1 bar, market entry at next bar open, 3-hour hold)

logic.entry: Last closed H1 bar has |close-open| > 2.5 x ATR24 (ATR24 = mean high-low of the last 24 H1 bars incl. the signal bar). Market order in the candle's direction at the next bar open. Skipped if any of the 3 held hours falls in 20:00-22:59 UTC, if a position is open, or if spread > 3.0.
logic.exit: Time exit at the close of the 3rd H1 bar (3 hours after entry) unless the stop is hit first.
logic.stop: Hard server-side stop = 2.0 x ATR24 from entry (median ~$7-8 at 0.1 ETH; worst realised loss $8.56).
logic.take_profit: None (a 2x ATR TP was tested and reduced OOS PF).
logic.sizing: Fixed broker minimum 0.1 ETH. cBot option: risk-% sizing, never below minimum, capped by MaxRiskPercent (4%) and MaxVolumeUnits.
logic.risk: One position; daily loss limit 5% of day-start balance; equity kill-switch at -25% from peak (closes and stops the bot); pause 48h after 6 consecutive losses; spread filter; recommended balance $300 (evaluator recommended_min $285, technical_min $107).

parameters.name: hold
parameters.meaning: H1 bars held incl. entry bar (engine max_bars = hold-1)

parameters.name: block
parameters.meaning: hours in which a position may never be held

trade_examples.why: crash-hour candle -161 vs ATR 45 (3.6x); continuation during the Aug-2024 deleveraging, time exit
+323 candle vs ATR 57 (5.7x) at US session; momentum carried 3h, time exit
+165 rebound candle vs ATR 54 (3.1x); continuation, time exit
-146 candle vs ATR 43; sharp reversal hit the 2xATR stop (worst trade of the sample)
-110 capitulation candle (tariff-crash low); V-shaped bounce stopped it out

failure_conditions: Quiet, mean-reverting regimes: 2023 (H2) PF 0.74 and 2026-06..11 PF ~1.0 - the edge comes in bursts during high-volatility trend phases
Fat-tail dependence: PF 1.82 -> 1.40 without the 5 best trades, 1.11 without the 10 best; long flat stretches are normal
Spread widening / slippage at shock bars beyond 2x modelled (spread x2 still PF 1.55, t 1.99)
Late execution: the effect decays within ~3h; entering more than a few minutes after the H1 close, or on coarser bars (H2 PF 0.87), removes it
Broker changes ETH minimum volume or rollover time (guard assumes rollover inside 20:00-22:59 UTC)
